title: 校队选拔
excerpt:
社团课，食堂三楼体育馆进行了校队选拔比赛。参与选拔的同学挑战了上届校乒赛单打冠军陈瑜萱和社长祁子傲。
最终入选：谷子易、龚雨煊、姜子润、彭一和

excerpt_en:
A school team selection tournament was held during club period in the gymnasium on the third floor of the canteen building. The students who tried out took on CHEN Yuxuan, the reigning School Championship singles champion, and club President QI Ziao.
Final selections: GU Ziyi, GONG Yuxuan, JIANG Zirun, PENG Yihe
